UserProfileDocument.title: UserProfileDocument
UserProfileDocument.description: Represents the authenticated user's personal profile, fiscal NCF settings, and linked Tarjeta Bravísima identifier in BravoVa.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this profile.

name.description: Full display name of the user.

email.description: User's contact email address (PII protected per owner).

phone.description: User's contact phone number (PII protected per owner).

cedula.description: Dominican national ID or document number (PII protected per owner).

bravisimaNumber.description: Immutable linked Tarjeta Bravísima number (e.g., BRV-8842-9901-7234).

rncNit.description: Taxpayer RNC identifier for fiscal invoices (NCF).

ncfType.description: Preferred fiscal invoice type (e.g., 'B01 - Crédito Fiscal', 'B02 - Consumidor Final').

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CartItemDocument.title: CartItemDocument
CartItemDocument.description: Represents a single product line item in the authenticated user's active shopping cart synced across devices.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this cart item.

sku.description: Product SKU identifier matching the document ID (e.g., 'BRV-001' or 'ARC-001').

qty.description: Quantity of the product in the cart (1 to 999).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cart item was added (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cart item quantity was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

OrderDocument.title: OrderDocument
OrderDocument.description: Represents a purchase order in the user's purchase history on BravoVa, used for cross-device synchronization and Brav IA habit analysis.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this order.

badgeNum.description: Total item count in the order.

date.description: Human-readable date or relative timestamp label.

branch.description: Supermercados Bravo branch that fulfilled the order.

skus.description: List of product SKUs included in the order (max 50).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the order record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the order record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ShoppingListDocument.title: ShoppingListDocument
ShoppingListDocument.description: Represents a user or Brav IA smart shopping list synchronized across devices.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this shopping list.

name.description: Display title of the shopping list.

skus.description: List of product SKUs in the shopping list (max 50).

aiNote.description: Optional note from Brav IA explaining why items were suggested from purchase history.

isAiGenerated.description: Whether the list was generated or auto-populated by Brav IA.

updatedAtLabel.description: Human-readable synchronization or AI status label.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shopping list was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shopping list was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BravisimaCardDocument.title: BravisimaCardDocument
BravisimaCardDocument.description: Represents the authenticated user's digital Tarjeta Bravísima loyalty card, balance, preferences, and security status synced in Firestore.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this Bravísima card.

cardNumber.description: Formatted unique Tarjeta Bravísima identifier (e.g., BRV-8842-9901-7234).

holderEmail.description: Optional Google account email associated with the card.

lifetimeEarned.description: Total accumulated cashback in RD$ used to determine loyalty tier.

status.description: Card security status (active or temporarily locked).

autoRedeemInCart.description: Whether Bravísima balance is automatically applied during checkout.

monthlyGoal.description: User's monthly cashback savings goal in RD$.

preferredCategory.description: Preferred store category for bonus cashback alerts.

claimedPromoCodes.description: Bounded list of promotional codes already redeemed on this card (max 20).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the card document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the card document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BravisimaMovementDocument.title: BravisimaMovementDocument
BravisimaMovementDocument.description: Represents a loyalty cashback earn, redemption, or promotional bonus ledger entry on the user's Tarjeta Bravísima.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this movement entry.

title.description: Movement title shown in the Bravísima ledger.

amount.description: Signed movement amount in RD$ (positive for earn/bonus, negative for redeem).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the movement was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the movement was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/profile/{profileId}.description: User-scoped personal profile, contact PII, fiscal NCF settings, and immutable Tarjeta Bravísima reference.

/users/{userId}/cart/{cartItemId}.description: User-scoped shopping cart items synchronized across devices.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: User-scoped purchase history orders used for order tracking, re-ordering, and Brav IA frequency analysis.

/users/{userId}/shoppingLists/{listId}.description: User-scoped shopping lists created manually or auto-populated by Brav IA based on purchase history.

/users/{userId}/bravisimaCards/{cardId}.description: User-scoped Tarjeta Bravísima loyalty card state, balance, lock toggle, and preferences.

/users/{userId}/bravisimaMovements/{move.description: User-scoped Tarjeta Bravísima cashback earn, promo bonus, and redemption history entries.
